criterion_text: Concurrent Session creation, retry/timeout, and deletion preserve image/writable-resource ownership, never duplicate an already-created tmux Session or delete another Session's active artifacts, and report truthful recoverable state.

verifiers.summary: Concurrent, retried and deleted Managed creations keep attempt, workspace and image ownership with truthful recoverable state

evidence.value: exact SHA 4745ddbfa9426b1470967bb988242b496a6ae02e: a losing attempt could not overwrite the winning attempt's ready managed context; a same-named attempt against a ready Session was refused before reaching the Agent and left the winner's attempt, workspace and status intact; a refused attempt was recorded failed and a retry of the same name reached ready with a new attempt id

exact SHA 4745ddbfa9426b1470967bb988242b496a6ae02e: two preparations over the same shared image set reused the warm cache (zero additional transfers) and received distinct Agent-owned workspaces; concurrent cache callers shared one fetch per digest

exact SHA 4745ddbfa9426b1470967bb988242b496a6ae02e: deleting one Session's managed context left another Session's context and shared image bytes untouched; a session refresh during preparation did not erase the in-flight context, while a stale preparing or a ready context for a removed Session was reclaimed
